jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (1372 Broadway) — hybrid; regular office presence required
jobs.salary: $84,700–$136,150 base; target $100K is within range but not guaranteed
jobs.why: A traditional internal functional IT Business Analyst role posted October 5, 2026. Works with stakeholders to capture requirements, user stories, functional designs and acceptance criteria, improve processes, coordinate testing, resolve production issues, document systems and train users. Audrey's Orion Salesforce change work and media operations experience directly support this scope.
jobs.gap: Retail-domain practices and a 3–5 year IT-systems-experience requirement; Audrey has about 2 years 4 months titled BA plus earlier reporting operations, so employer's counting of related experience matters. Hybrid office frequency unspecified.
missingKeywords: 3–5 years IT systems support (duration depends on employer interpretation)

jobs.title: Business Analyst II
jobs.why: Traditional IT Business Analyst II role supporting internal systems: stakeholder requirements, process/gap analysis, business cases, functional requirements, testing and UAT, vendor coordination, production support, documentation and training. Strong overlap with Audrey's Orion Legal/Finance process and Salesforce enhancements.
jobs.gap: Posting requires 3+ years in software development lifecycle and 2+ years using BABOK practices; Audrey's ~2 years 4 months BA plus earlier ops may not satisfy formal SDLC threshold. MS Project, formal PMBOK/BABOK application and end-to-end cutover planning are not established. On-site and possible after-hours/weekends.
